selection_policy: Ten explicitly targeted official documents, two per actor. Not representative sampling or verified retrieval. UN speech landing pages must resolve to exactly one official manifest-language PDF, never a press summary. EU press-release targets were replaced with separately published official UN statements because Consilium robots.txt disallows this collector. The original failures are retained in the pilot audit documentation. EU 2023 has a French full statement only; retain French, do not use AI-generated transcripts or translate as evidence.
access_policy: Check robots before requests, cache failures and downloads, one second minimum per host, local research cache only. Full terms review and source/date verification pending access. Do not redistribute downloaded texts without rights review.
